threat_model.lock_rule: Every production writer must retain the exact prefix lock FD and hold an exclusive flock before observing or mutating the runtime namespace.

authority.acceptance: No writer is routable until its lock.status is exact-exclusive-flock and its path/symbol is registered here.

source_forest.closure_rule: The src root is the source-forest origin; pinned build/install targets must be reached by recursive add_subdirectory traversal, while conditional targets are represented by build_closure entries. Legacy source grouping roots are audited separately and are not build membership claims.

universe.rule: Mutation-first discovery scans every translation unit under darling/src plus the complete workspace west_commands and lifecycle operation-boundary runtime roots using namespace_mutation_tokens; recursive CMake closure and conditional build_closure entries anchor the production forest, while production_roots are owner grouping metadata only.

audited_non_shared_candidates.rule: Every mutation-first candidate not listed as a typed writer or exact exclusion must have one SHA-bound per-path classification, reason, and build/runtime evidence entry; no implicit remainder classification is permitted.
